CLINK.justification: the sequential connection of the shift and extraction operations

EVALF.justification: the failure to map the phoneme resulting in a null magnitude

FFUSE.justification: the recombination of the promotion result into a single localized object

FSPLIT.justification: the divergence where the system evaluates the validity of the 𐑯 to 𐑬 promotion

IFIX.justification: the permanent append-only log of the extracted dimensionful values

TANCH.justification: the final bounded output containing the extracted spatial values

VINIT.justification: the state of raw data before any localization or mapping occurs
